ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

2. When practising Language structures School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language structures School.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language structures School.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language structures School.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.

3. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

4. When practising Pronunciation and Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

5. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. going
   C. goes
   D. went

6. When practising Pre-reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre-reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre-reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-reading.

7. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only an action
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

8. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

9. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.

10. When practising Connected text reading and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text reading and fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text reading and fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text reading and fluency.

11. When practising Word reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Word reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word reading.

12. When practising Letter sound knowledge, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Letter sound knowledge.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Letter sound knowledge.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Letter sound knowledge.

13. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.

14. When practising Pre- Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre- Writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre- Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre- Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre- Writing.

15. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. happiness
   C. quickly
   D. run

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Pre- Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
